module_name: Keys stay with the QNC keyboard catalog
input: The egui context of the frame, before its keys are read.
output: Keyboard focus taken away from every widget that is not a text field (button, card, tab, combo box); a text field keeps it for typing.
specification: User rule 2026-10-13: Tab walks the panels of a form and Alt+ jumps; egui's own Tab walk over widgets must not take the keys from the QNC keyboard catalog.
